note: The universe's stories for the atlas's Stories list (one/one.js, one/phone.js) and for /universe/, which plays them. A chapter names one of the film's turning points by its title (MOMENTS in universe.js), or carries its own scene (s), seconds into it (at), title, when, text and src.

stories.title: The first three minutes
stories.range: 13.8 billion years ago: the first 20 minutes
stories.summary: From the edge of known physics to the first atomic nuclei: how the universe's raw ingredients were made in a few minutes.

stories.title: From first light to the first stars
stories.range: 50,000 to 200 million years after the Big Bang
stories.summary: The fog clears, the universe goes dark, and gravity slowly gathers matter until the first stars switch on.

chapters.title: The dark ages
chapters.text: No stars yet. In the dark, gravity draws dark matter and gas into a web of strands and knots, while the leftover light cools from 3,000 K to about 85 K.
chapters.src: Planck Collaboration 2018, dark and ordinary matter

stories.title: The first galaxies
stories.range: About 280 million to 1 billion years after the Big Bang
stories.summary: Young galaxies, giant black holes, and the light that cleared the hydrogen haze between them.

stories.title: Our galaxy and the Sun
stories.range: Over 12 billion to 4.6 billion years ago
stories.summary: How the Milky Way grew, swallowed a neighbour, and finally made the Sun, where the Earth's own story begins.
